sources.snippet: Update: Nemotron 3 Ultra is now released! Ultra Blog We announce NVIDIA Nemotron 3, the most efficient family of open models with leading accuracy for agentic AI applications. The Nemotron 3 family consists of three models: Nano, Super, and Ultra. These models deliver strong agentic, reasoning, and conversational capabilities.

sources.title: FurniMesh — AI Image to 3D Model Generator for Furniture
sources.snippet: FurniMesh is an AI image to 3D platform that turns furniture photos into production-ready 3D models in under 60 seconds. Upload a photo of a chair, sofa, table, lamp, or any furniture piece, and the AI returns a textured 3D model in GLB, OBJ, SKP, or BLEND format.
